title: The therapeutic effect of nicotinamide riboside chloride on ameliorating alcohol-induced neuronal damage with a focus on mitochondrial unfolded protein response and mitophagy.
target: Mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt) and Fundc1-dependent mitophagy
design: Preclinical (in vivo behavioral tests plus in vitro molecular assays, proteomics and GEO analysis)

outcomes.name: Alcohol-related cognitive impairment
outcomes.effect_text: NRC significantly improved alcohol-related cognitive impairment

outcomes.name: Mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt)
outcomes.effect_text: NRC supplementation restored mitochondrial homeostasis by enhancing UPRmt
